newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.11 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.11 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1300 to the dollar, down from 3.1200 on Monday and at 1.8060 to the mark, up from 1.8110, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.11 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, slightly stronger than Monday's 3.09 percent fix.
The zloty was fixed at 3.09 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with intraday currency swings on world markets, flat from Monday's 3.09 percent fixing.
